overlay_single_addition_to_played_union_.classification_evidence: The frozen choice changed ZERO games in the holdout half (interim_hc fires on 5 games across the whole 1,503-game archive and none of them fall in 2023-2025), so the holdout marginal is identically 0.000 with a degenerate interval. That is an uninformative read, not a refutation: no wrong sign is resolved, no reliability is zero, no positive control bounded anything. Category 3. Recorded so the DECISION -- no production change -- rests on a registry entry rather than on prose.
overlay_single_addition_to_played_union_.description: Adding ONE further overlay to the PLAYED four-member union (coach + division_revenge + player_arrests + spread_gap_zone), chosen from ten candidates on opener seasons 2020-2022 ONLY and applied unchanged to 2023-2025. A far smaller selection space than the 4,095-subset re-selection. Frozen choice: interim_hc_first_game_tilt_overlay (+0.142 on the selection half, the only candidate with a positive marginal there).
overlay_single_addition_to_played_union_.notes: Two holdout numbers deliberately NOT acted on because both ranked negative on the selection half, so using them would be selecting on the holdout: pbp08_protection_mismatch_tilt_overlay +1.001 pts week P+ 0.8978 (selection half -0.284), forecast_cold_visitor_tilt +0.501 pts P+ 0.9039 (selection half -0.142). Both remain ACTIVE_PROSPECTIVE challengers and 2026 supplies an independent read. Separately measured, as additions to the played union and consistent across BOTH halves: injury_value_lost_tilt_overlay -3.835/-1.252, surface_switch_tilt_overlay -0.284/-1.627 (holdout P+ 0.0220), backup_qb_fade_overlay -0.994/-1.377. That closes nothing about any of them standing alone -- no interval sits wholly on the wrong side of zero on both blockings and no reliability or positive control was run -- it measures only that they subtract as additions to THIS four-member policy on THIS archive.
overlay_single_addition_to_played_union_.plain_summary: Sanity check: tests adding a first-year coach's first-game rule.

overlay_subset_reselection_twelve_member.classification_evidence: No admissible closing ground. The sign is not resolved on both blockings and no positive control was run, so this is category 3 despite leaning against re-selection. What is measured: widening the candidate pool from 7 members/127 subsets to 12 members/4,095 subsets LOWERED the shrinkage factor from 0.636 to 0.593 and rank stability from Spearman 0.721 to 0.617 -- more candidates bought more selection noise than signal. probability_positive is an approximate read off the two arms' own bootstrap distributions, not a paired resample of the difference; treat the point estimate and the shrinkage factors as the finding.
overlay_subset_reselection_twelve_member.description: Re-selecting the played overlay composition from all 4,095 subsets of TWELVE pick-flipping members, chosen on opener seasons 2020-2022 ONLY and applied unchanged to 2023-2025. Predeclared decider in scripts/overlay_subset_holdout_v2.py before any output existed. Effect is the selected subset's holdout delta MINUS the former coach->arrests chain's holdout delta on the identical 799 games (+0.626 vs +0.876).
overlay_subset_reselection_twelve_member.notes: Control arms measured the same way: naive all-twelve stack on the holdout scores -2.128 accuracy points (501 of 799 games flipped). The PLAYED policy is the four-member union overlay_union_coach_division_revenge_player_arrests_spread_gap_v1 at 55.4225% on 1,503 opener games, +2.063 vs the 53.3599% raw model -- verified by running record_paper_decisions itself, not by reading a study's baseline label. Attribution ceiling: every member was registered on windows overlapping this archive, so the holdout is virgin for the SUBSET CHOICE only, never for the components.
overlay_subset_reselection_twelve_member.plain_summary: Sanity check: best of twelve candidate overlays, re-picked and retested.
